hooks.command: R="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; cd "$R" || exit 0; git status --porcelain | grep -q . || exit 0; OUT=$(pnpm run verify:fast 2>&1) || printf '%s' "$OUT" | tail -25 | python3 -c "import json,sys; json.dump({'decision':'block','reason':'pnpm run verify:fast failed. Fix it before finishing:\n\n' + sys.stdin.read()}, sys.stdout)"
